title: Binary guard machine
statement: For each $b\in\mathbb{N}$, the binary guard machine is the one-work-tape Boolean machine whose state set consists of loop states built from $\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Fin}(b+1))$. It is obtained by placing the guard block for $b$ inside the counter-loop machine, with initial guard phase $0$ and initial counter value $\mathrm{some}(\mathrm{none})$.
